steps.command: data modify block $x+7 200 -1 TankContent set value {FluidName:"minecraft:lava",Amount:1}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+7 200 -1 create:fluid_tank{TankContent:{FluidName:\"minecraft:lava\",Amount:1}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 white_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+3 200 -1 amendments:liquid_cauldron{sd_milk_mb:1} if block $x+3 201 -1 amendments:liquid_cauldron[boiling=true] run setblock $x-1 200 0 yellow_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+3 200 -1 minecraft:cauldron if block $x+3 201 -1 amendments:liquid_cauldron[boiling=false] run setblock $x-1 200 0 blue_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+7 200 -1 create:fluid_tank{TankContent:{FluidName:\"minecraft:lava\",Amount:1}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 cyan_concrete"}
setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+3 201 -1 create:fluid_tank{Boiler:{Engines:1,PassiveHeat:0b}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 gray_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+3 200 -1 amendments:liquid_cauldron{sd_milk_mb:1} if block $x+3 201 -1 create:fluid_tank{Boiler:{PassiveHeat:1b,ActiveHeat:0}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 orange_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+3 200 -1 minecraft:cauldron if block $x+3 201 -1 create:fluid_tank{Boiler:{Engines:1,PassiveHeat:0b,ActiveHeat:0}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 green_concrete"}

setblock $x-2 200 0 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block $x+7 200 -1 create:fluid_tank{TankContent:{FluidName:\"minecraft:lava\",Amount:1}} run setblock $x-1 200 0 purple_concrete"}
